rev.t: Honestly a really nice place which give you the feeling of luxury. The items taste very pure to the ingredients and if you don't really like the actual taste of whatever you've ordered (and not the Indianized version) then it's not a place …

While Smoor is synonymous with high-end couverture chocolates and pastries, their Indiranagar outlet continues to prove that their savory menu is equally deserving of attention. It is a fantastic spot for a refined, light meal in a chic, …

Place is having nice sitting arrangements. Their service is too very good they are very responsive and courteous. We had Pastries and noodles..Taste of the food items good. We also tried their thai curry and rice which was good but could have been better . It is a nice confectionery  and restaurant .
